label: TDH3
note: S. cerevisiae TDH3 (glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase 3) promoter, commonly called GPD or GAP; strong constitutive. Extracted from a TDH3-driven yeast vector (Addgene 239293), GAP promoter feature (668 bp).

provenance.sequence_source: NC_001139.9 (Saccharomyces cerevisiae S288C chromosome VII, SGD-curated RefSeq identical to BK006941; Tettelin et al. 1997) 883811..884477, reverse strand, identical over 667 bp, ending just before the TDH3 (YGR192C) start codon at 883810..883808. The part held one more A in the A-run at its position 228 (668 bp) until 2026-11; no deposit carried that form.
